Current release

Version 0.11.0

2026-06-17

Changes

  • Rebuilt the Turret XP GUI around an anchored Factorio-native flib.gui shell with focused services for shell ownership, runtime refresh, actions, core identity, label controls, platform controls, Stats, Evolution, widgets, and the Veteran Core picker table.
  • Reworked empty turrets into a full-width Veteran Core picker with sortable headers, Base/Sniper/Machine gun/Bulwark/Brawler filters, persisted sort/filter preferences, neutral preview stats, and exact-slot install actions.
  • Reworked installed-core controls with a compact identity/action row, explicit extract and Bind/Unbind actions, platform hub core rows, a label-color swatch, and a draggable Turret XP color popup with presets and RGB sliders.
  • Gave Stats and Evolution matching fixed-header shallow panes with bounded scroll bodies, native section headers, named layout constants, stable row budgets, and regression guards for layout contracts.
  • Added dev-only GUI snapshot tooling for graphical review of fixture scenes, plus headless and script-level GUI contract tests for the picker, Stats layout, action dispatch, and layout constants.
  • Added Dockerized Lua formatting/linting workflows and a pre-commit hook so local Lua formatting and strict checks match CI without installing Lua tools on the host.

Bugfixes

  • Fixed interface-scale-sensitive Evolution icons by rendering decorative sprites in fixed cells so they no longer overflow into labels or action controls at smaller or automatic UI scales.
  • Fixed Ammo-section stat alignment so Magazine, Ammo, and Ammo Productivity values are pinned to the same right-side value column as the rest of the Stats panel.
  • Reduced GUI refresh churn by preserving stable interactive controls and using narrower refresh keys for picker and open-turret updates where practical.

What It Does

Veteran Cores

Only chosen turrets become unique. A core stores XP, upgrades, elements, name, and battle history, then moves by itself or bound to its turret body when the front line shifts.

Combat Growth

Turrets earn XP from damage and kill contribution. Points buy damage, shield, ammo productivity, shield-on-hit, repair, crits, luck, double shots, XP gain, and bouncing bullets. Brawler lists 10% Lifesteal as an innate specialization stat.

Specialized Defenders

Choose strong identities with tradeoffs: long-range snipers, rapid machine guns, tough bulwarks, or brutal close-range brawlers.

Element Projects

Pick fire, electric, explosive, or toxic effects, feed larger passive material ranks to strengthen them, and combine two elements on veteran turrets.

Playtest Path

Install from the in-game Mods interface, place a gun turret, install a Veteran Core, add ammo, and let it fight.

  1. Install or dev-create a Veteran Core.
  2. Let the turret shoot enemies.
  3. Check that XP and lifetime damage increase.
  4. Name the core, toggle its floating label, and move it to another turret or bind it for one-item turret moves.
  5. Run /turret-xp-dev to test level gates, complete passive element material ranks, then buy an upgrade or augment.
  6. Report confusing stats, pacing issues, or runtime errors.
